name: elochair
description: Submission and peer-review system for the Electronic Literature Organization conference

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/schema && tsc -p packages/policy && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web
scripts.e2e: npm run build && npm run e2e -w @elochair/web
